tagline.en: Yellow taxis under towers of glass, and a warm pretzel.
tagline.he: מוניות צהובות מתחת למגדלי זכוכית, ובייגלה חם.

item.en: yellow taxis stopped at a crossing

success.en: You found me between the taxis!

hintText.en: Look by the yellow taxis at the crossing.
hintText.he: חפשו ליד המוניות הצהובות במעבר החצייה.

placement.support: Both shoes rest on the visible street immediately in front of the stopped yellow taxi.
placement.occlusion: None; the child is in front of the taxi and may naturally cover part of its door, panel, and lower trim.
placement.instructions: Stand facing the viewer with feet together and arms close. Use child proportions and make the child slightly shorter than nearby crossing pedestrians.

hintText.en: Look by the taxis on the right.

item.en: a street cart selling warm pretzels

success.en: The salt got on my nose.

placement.support: Both shoes on the paved sidewalk in front of the cart's right lower panel, between the small girl on the left and the vendor on the right.
placement.occlusion: None; the child stands in front of the cart and may cover part of its lower panel, bottles and wheel.
placement.instructions: A school-age child stands facing the pretzel cart, in the narrow gap between the small girl in the purple top on the left and the vendor in the apron on the right. Do not touch or merge with either of them; only the cart is behind the child.

hintText.en: Look by the second cart on the left.

mission.en: Find {name} hiding behind a park bench

item.en: park benches under autumn trees, with pigeons
item.he: ספסלי פארק מתחת לעצי סתיו, עם יונים

success.en: The pigeons almost gave me away!
You found me! The leaves are so orange.

hintText.en: Look behind the benches in the park.

placement.support: Hidden feet are planted on the park path behind the bench; bodyHeight is the child's implied full standing height.
placement.occlusion: The original bench backrest provides the exact cutoff across the lower shoulders; the crouched torso and legs remain behind it.
placement.instructions: Crouch behind the bench and peek above its backrest with the full face and top of the shoulders visible. Keep hands and lower body hidden. Only the part of the child above the occluder is painted; the rest of the body continues behind it and is not shown.

hintText.en: Look behind the bench on the right.

artNotes: a canyon of glass and brick skyscrapers going up out of frame
wooden water towers on the rooftops
black iron fire escapes zigzagging down the buildings
a dog walker holding six leads at once
steam rising from a manhole between the taxis
chess players on a stone table at the park edge

completeText.en: You found {name} three times in New York!
completeText.he: מצאתם את {name} שלוש פעמים בניו יורק!

artComposition: Keep the elevated angle over the crowd, but make the SKYLINE dominate: a canyon of very tall skyscrapers fills the whole upper half on both sides and recedes into the distance, so the city is unmistakable at a glance. Water towers on the roofs, fire escapes down the brick fronts, a steel suspension bridge far behind. The street below is a wide crossing with yellow taxis.
